hook: Moire graphene shows evidence of a self-formed electron crystal with quantized Hall states.
summary: Transport and noise measurements in hole-doped moire rhombohedral graphene reveal Chern insulators across a continuous range of densities that do not match the moire lattice. They also show current-induced noise, memory effects and gate hysteresis, pointing to a spontaneously charge-ordered parent state. The evidence is indirect, with no direct imaging of the crystal.
title: Evidence of anomalous Hall crystals in moir\'e rhombohedral graphene
